LegalDocument.title: Legal Document
LegalDocument.description: A legal brief, contract, motion, or memorandum authored by an attorney

userId.description: Unique identifier of the authoring lawyer

title.description: Document title (e.g. Motion for Summary Judgment)

jurisdiction.description: Target legal jurisdiction (e.g. US Federal, California, New York, Delaware, General US)

matterRef.description: Client matter or file reference number

content.description: Full drafted text and clauses of the legal document

status.description: Current status of the document draft

lastAuditSummary.description: Concise summary of the latest AI case law audit

AuditRecord.title: Compliance Audit Record
AuditRecord.description: AI analysis record evaluating compliance with applicable case law and statutory requirements

userId.description: Unique identifier of the owning user

overallAssessment.description: Executive legal summary of compliance findings

issues.description: List of flagged legal risks and discrepancies

citations.description: List of verified case law citations supporting or challenging the draft

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when audit was performed

/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}.description: Collection of legal documents belonging to a lawyer

/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}/a.description: History of AI case law compliance audits conducted for a document
